plate.title: Two-hole mounting plate
plate.description: A measured outline and two through-holes: a useful first parametric part.

parameters.label: Length
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic teaching default; replace with the reviewed overall length.

parameters.label: Width
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic teaching default; replace with the reviewed overall width.

parameters.label: Thickness
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic teaching default; measure thickness independently from the photograph.

parameters.label: Hole diameter
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic teaching default; review the mating fastener and fit before use.

parameters.label: Hole center spacing
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic teaching default; replace with reviewed center-to-center spacing.

parameters.label: Radial chord error
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen polygon tessellation setting for this teaching model.
parameters.notes: Geometric tessellation setting, not printer accuracy.

parameters.label: Minimum wall rule
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen geometric minimum for the teaching plate.
parameters.notes: Not a strength or material qualification.

coupon.title: Diametral clearance coupon
coupon.description: Test a sequence of hole sizes against a real mating pin before committing to a larger print.

parameters.label: Nominal pin diameter
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic teaching default; measure the actual mating pin before a fit test.

parameters.label: First diametral clearance
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen start of an example test series.
parameters.notes: Diametral clearance; not radial clearance or a recommended fit.

parameters.label: Clearance increment
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen increment for the example test series.
parameters.notes: Test using intended material, orientation and finish.

parameters.label: Thickness
parameters.source_or_rationale: Synthetic coupon thickness for the teaching example.

parameters.label: Minimum wall
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen geometric minimum between holes and long edges.

parameters.label: End wall
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen material from outer hole polygons to the coupon ends.
parameters.notes: Must be at least the minimum wall.

parameters.label: Radial chord error
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen polygon tessellation setting for the teaching coupon.
parameters.notes: Polygon flats are compensated to preserve the requested opening.

parameters.label: Index notch size
parameters.source_or_rationale: Chosen corner-notch leg length to mark the smallest-clearance end.
parameters.notes: Notch must preserve the minimum wall to the first hole.
